title: rosa dumalis f. racemulosa
intro: Rosa dumalis f. racemulosa, commonly known as Himalayan rose or Wild Himalayan rose, is a flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Rosa dumalis f. racemulosa is reported to have therapeutic actions such as reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
